selection_reasons.message: Selected at panel rank 1 to satisfy the 'one_per_class' design objective.
Produces one predicted product for 1 mature-cDNA equivalence class(es).
Spans 1 external evidence-derived junction target(s); this records region influence, not exact probe-sequence reuse.

notes: Projected probe-region geometry influenced the assay target; GENtle did not reuse or match an array-probe sequence.

primer_pair_summary.genomic_carryover_rationale: Transcript-panel selection does not run a genomic-template PCR carryover test; requested junction overlap is reported separately and must not be interpreted as a whole-genome specificity pass.
